s177.sec6.u0: This humble one knows a little about items. There are 128 kinds of items in all, so it is said. Of those, 32 are food! Some grow on their own in one region and nowhere else. Quite rare, they are! For example, in Native Forest you can find the Blue Apple. Foods like these have special effects. So think hard about when to eat them!
s177.sec6.u1: This time, this humble one will speak of Digivolution items. Just as the name says, a Digivolution item makes a Digimon Digivolve. There are all sorts, one for each kind of Digimon, so it is said. For example, use Grey Claws and you become Greymon! Digivolution items are legendary items. Some of them exist only once in the whole world, so it is said. But next to normal Digivolving, you get no stat bonus, and its mood drops. Not much of a bargain! Still, becoming the Digimon you want right away... that is quite the charm! But it only works from the stage just before. Be careful about that!
